verdict.rationale: Gitea's own GitHub README states it provides an official Go SDK, so developers can build against a first-party SDK. The evidence is a single thin mention covering only one language, with no SDK documentation, usage examples, or versioning details. The OpenAPI/Swagger spec is a building block for generating clients, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: official SDKs in languages beyond Go, SDK documentation and examples, SDK versioning and compatibility guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
